tts.setProvider.basis: persists tts.provider through the canonical confirm-gated settings write (voicebridge.qubit_compat.config_save), the exact setting voicebridge/orchestrator._make_tts reads to build the TTS adapter; an unknown provider is a typed GATEWAY_BAD_PARAMS refusal

users.authConnect.answer.basis: no external auth-connect session exists to answer; the typed code is returned
users.authConnect.answer.operator_prerequisite: a live external provider OAuth/connect service and network access

users.authConnect.cancel.basis: no external auth-connect session exists to cancel; the typed code is returned
users.authConnect.cancel.operator_prerequisite: a live external provider OAuth/connect service and network access

users.authConnect.catalog.basis: upstream catalogs external auth-connect providers/methods; Qubit returns its real configured provider registry and manual-handoff portals and emits its own code

users.authConnect.start.basis: starting an external provider auth-connect session needs a live OAuth service Qubit does not run; the typed code is returned
users.authConnect.start.operator_prerequisite: a live external provider OAuth/connect service and network access
users.authConnect.start.qubit_counterpart: CLI `qubit auth login --provider <name>` (manual handoff; Qubit never performs the OAuth dance)

users.authConnect.status.basis: no external auth-connect session exists to report; the typed code is returned
users.authConnect.status.operator_prerequisite: a live external provider OAuth/connect service and network access

users.github.authorize.cancel.basis: no GitHub device-flow authorization exists to cancel; the typed code is returned
users.github.authorize.cancel.operator_prerequisite: a started GitHub device-flow authorization (requires the live OAuth app)
users.github.authorize.cancel.qubit_counterpart: nothing to cancel locally; remove the credential reference with the operator's own tooling

users.github.authorize.poll.basis: Qubit polls no external OAuth service and has no device-flow session in flight; the typed code is returned
users.github.authorize.poll.operator_prerequisite: a started GitHub device-flow authorization (requires the live OAuth app)
users.github.authorize.poll.qubit_counterpart: CLI `qubit auth verify --provider github` (reference presence only)

users.github.authorize.start.basis: the GitHub device-flow authorization needs a live github.com OAuth app Qubit does not run; no device flow is started and the typed code is returned
users.github.authorize.start.operator_prerequisite: a live GitHub OAuth app/device-flow service and network access
users.github.authorize.start.qubit_counterpart: CLI `qubit auth login --provider github` (manual handoff in the operator's browser)

users.github.disconnect.basis: Qubit holds no personal GitHub connection to disconnect; the typed code is returned
users.github.disconnect.operator_prerequisite: a linked GitHub account (requires the live OAuth app)

users.github.status.basis: Qubit stores credential references only and runs no GitHub OAuth/app service, so no personal GitHub status is fetched; the typed code is returned
users.github.status.operator_prerequisite: a GitHub credential reference (env:/file:) with the required scopes and network access
users.github.status.qubit_counterpart: CLI `qubit auth status` + an operator-managed credential reference

users.linkAuthProfile.basis: upstream links a shared credential to a user profile; Qubit is single-operator, so it performs the real confirm-gated credential-pool add from an env:/file: reference and emits its own code

users.linkEmail.basis: Qubit has no email identity service and stores no operator email; the typed code is returned

users.list.basis: upstream lists a multi-user profile directory; Qubit is single-operator with no profile store, so it returns the one real loopback operator identity and emits its own code

users.listAuthLinks.basis: upstream lists per-user linked auth profiles; Qubit is single-operator with no per-user links, so it returns the canonical credential-reference inventory and emits its own code

users.listModelAccounts.basis: upstream lists per-user model accounts; Qubit returns its canonical single-operator model-profile registry and emits its own code

users.mentionable.basis: upstream exposes a multi-user mention directory; Qubit has one operator, so the mentionable set is that real identity and the handler emits its own code

users.prefs.get.basis: upstream reads arbitrary per-profile key/values; Qubit returns the real persisted dashboard preferences (font/theme) and emits its own code

users.prefs.set.basis: upstream writes arbitrary per-profile key/values; Qubit persists only its real supported dashboard preferences (font/theme) and emits its own code

users.selectModelAccount.basis: upstream selects a per-user model account; Qubit performs the real confirm-gated session->profile selection in its canonical registry and emits its own code

users.self.basis: upstream resolves the authenticated multi-user profile; Qubit returns its one real loopback operator identity instead and emits its own code

users.setAvatar.basis: Qubit keeps no operator avatar/media store and hosts no avatar media, so no avatar is written; the typed code is returned
users.setAvatar.operator_prerequisite: an operator-managed avatar/media store and hosting
users.setAvatar.qubit_counterpart: voicebridge.device.profile (local device identity; no avatar field)

users.setDisplayName.basis: Qubit is single-operator with no mutable multi-user profile store, so no display name is written; the typed code is returned
users.setDisplayName.operator_prerequisite: a multi-user profile store (Qubit is single-operator)

users.setRole.basis: Qubit has no multi-user role store and fixed operator scopes, so no role is assigned; the typed code is returned
users.setRole.operator_prerequisite: a multi-user profile/role store (Qubit is single-operator)
users.setRole.qubit_counterpart: the fixed operator scopes advertised by the gateway `connect` handshake

users.unlinkAuthProfile.basis: upstream unlinks a credential from a user profile; Qubit performs the real confirm-gated credential-pool removal and emits its own code

worktrees.branches.basis: real `git for-each-ref` heads/remotes with checked-out worktree mapping, the same projection as `/api/git/branches`

worktrees.create.basis: confirmation-gated, project-root-confined `git worktree add` into `<root>/.worktrees/<name>` through the SAME `voicebridge.git_scope._run` the CLI/voice use

worktrees.gc.basis: upstream runs a managed-cache sweep with owner retention limits; Qubit runs the real local stale-metadata cleanup `git worktree prune --verbose` and emits its own code

worktrees.list.basis: `git worktree list --porcelain` through the scoped `voicebridge.git_scope` runner, the same rows the dashboard `/api/git/worktrees` read serves

worktrees.remove.basis: confirmation-gated `git worktree remove` + `git worktree prune`, confined to the project root; nothing outside the approved folder is touched

worktrees.restore.basis: upstream replays a managed snapshot from its worktree store; Qubit keeps no managed snapshot store, so this re-materializes the confined worktree with `git worktree add` and emits its own code

policy.note: Every contractual-pin method gets exactly one status. IMPLEMENTED requires a registered handler that performs real backend work; a refusal requires a real registered handler that emits its typed code. OPEN is reported and expected; it is not a disposition.
